name: Admin can manage people and roles

planSteps.description: Sign in as admin@soply.test with password Soply123! (fill the Email and Password fields on /login and click 'Sign in')
Click 'People & roles' in the Manage section of the sidebar
The page shows the heading 'People & roles' and a summary line with the total number of people
The user table lists 'Alex Rivera' (SOP author) and 'Monica Chen' (Approver) with their emails
Each row has a Role dropdown and a Department dropdown, and a Save button that is disabled while there are no changes
